During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Hero of Tython|Jedi Knight]] '''attacked''' an Imperial weapons factory in the [[Lower Industrial Sector]] of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] in hopes of shutting down the [[Power Guard Enhancement System|Power Guard Project]], which had been seized by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Sadic]]. However, the Knight instead found [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], who had been captured while searching for the project and transformed into a Power Guard. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] managed to defeat Galen and convince him to overcome his programming and aid in the fight, and the agent joined the Knight in [[Raid on Sadic's laboratory|attacking]] Sadic's laboratory.
